name: inkline
description: Turn a prompt, photo or SVG into a hand-drawn video: pencil, pen, marker, chalk or neon drawings that appear stroke by stroke, rendered locally from HTML/JS.

interface.longDescription: Draw photos, prompts and SVGs as videos: the drawing appears stroke by stroke with the tool in frame, then an optional colour wash and procedural drawing sound. Eleven styles plus your own as JSON. Renders locally with Node and headless Chrome after a one-time, user-approved setup.
defaultPrompt: Draw my photo as a pencil sketch video for Reels
Make a 15-second whiteboard video of a rocket launching
Turn logo.svg into a gold-ink drawing, square, with sound
